method: 109 OpenStreetMap building ways whose centroids lie inside the three OSM campus polygons (28028409, 26680824, 26680821), used verbatim as one MultiPolygon; the four buildings drawn on their own records (WEHA, WIHA, SINQ, WNAB) are excluded, building=roof canopies are left out, and building:part ways are not used. 91 of the 113 campus buildings carry PSI's four-letter code as their OSM name (WHGA, WSLA, OHLA ...); the legend of PSI's 2015 site map (src:psi-geo-arealplan-2015) explains the codes.
name: PSI West and East campus buildings (OpenStreetMap footprints)

summary.plain: The other buildings of the PSI campus on both banks of the Aare, drawn from OpenStreetMap for orientation.
